repacks.name: benilla
repacks.author: samwhosung
repacks.description: A complete Vanilla game client written from scratch in Rust and Bevy. The engine Open Vanilla is built on.
repacks.about: benilla connects to any Vanilla server and reads game data from your own Vanilla install; it ships no Blizzard content. It builds and runs on Windows, macOS and Linux. The Open Vanilla desktop client (OpenVanilla.exe) is a build of benilla.
credits: Vendored: kira audio engine, patched Lua 5.1

repacks.name: wenilla-realm
repacks.author: Arnesen
repacks.license: MIT (bundled parts keep their own licences)
repacks.description: A private, self-hosted realm friends can play from a browser tab: CMaNGOS, classic-db, the wenilla browser client and a relay, on one VM.
repacks.about: wenilla-realm bundles a CMaNGOS mangos-classic game server, classic-db world content, the wenilla browser client (benilla compiled to WebAssembly) and an admin and relay service with a setup wizard and control panel. Caddy handles HTTPS and Docker Compose runs everything on one VM. Players install nothing; the operator supplies their own client Data folder.

_note_clients: WrathUnleashed (3.3.5a) is the only realm: the HOME dropdown offers the player's own 3.3.5a client, which they point at their own game folder (never downloaded). The Vanilla 1.12.1 stock client and the engine are parked: Workshop > CLIENTS still lists them. Move entries between clients and clients_parked to change that.
